name: Test: .fxc sprite shader cost (C#)
author: test
summary: Measures the cost of .fxc sprite shaders: idle before and after the hooks, then 200 sprites with and without a shader, deferred and immediate.
description: Build with tools/tests/build-cs.sh csspritefxperf. Run with adb shell setprop debug.bl.spritefxprofile 1 for the native timers. Logs csspritefxperf PHASE <name> ... per phase and csspritefxperf END pass=N fail=M.
